Archival Dispatch: 25 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Early 1900s Acoustic Records, Psychedelic Radio Spots, Paul Harvey, and Ask Dr. Science

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 5 min
Tags: Early Acoustic Records, Billy Murray, Harry Macdonough, Psychedelic Promos, Velvet Underground, Box Tops, Paul Harvey, Rest of the Story, Ask Dr Science, Jack Teagarden, Apollo 11, Claybourne, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 73 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 73 recovers and dates 25 historical audio documents and radio broadcasts spanning dawn-of-sound turn-of-the-century acoustic discs, 1960s counterculture psychedelic spots, Paul Harvey's biographical radio twists, satirical science comedy, swing jazz trombone classics, NASA lunar mission transmissions, and 1990s gothic serials: 5 turn-of-the-century recordings from Early Recordings (1901–1908, featuring Billy Murray, Harry Macdonough, and Grace Spencer), 5 counterculture radio artifacts from Psychedelic Promos and Radio Spots (including The Velvet Underground's 1969 album promo, Dave Diamond's Diamond Mine on KBLA, and The Box Tops' Coca-Cola spot), 5 mystery biographies from Paul Harvey: The Rest of the Story (1978–1984), 5 episodes of public radio comedy from Ask Dr. Science (Duck's Breath Mystery Theatre, 1986–1991), 2 swing masterpieces from The Jack Teagarden Collection (1939), 2 lunar flight recordings from Apollo Space Missions Collection (Apollo 11, July 1969), and the New Zealand sci-fi horror serial Claybourne (1998).

1. Early Acoustic Recordings (1901–1908)

Primary acoustic recordings from Victor, Columbia, and Edison cylinders:

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate Acoustic Cylinder / Disc Release
Early_Billy_Murray_Rainbow.mp3 "Billy Murray and Haydn Quartet: 'Rainbow' (Victor Acoustic 78)" 1908-09-15 Tin Pan Alley hit featuring the leading recording star of the acoustic era.
Early_Tell_Me_Pretty_Maiden.mp3 "Harry Macdonough and Grace Spencer: 'Tell Me Pretty Maiden' (Florodora)" 1901-04-18 Landmark Broadway double sextette vocal duet from Florodora.
Early_Summer_Time_Redmond.mp3 "William Redmond: 'In the Good Old Summer Time'" 1902-11-20 Original acoustic rendition of George Evans' classic summer waltz.
Early_Under_Anheuser_Bush.mp3 "Billy Murray: 'Under the Anheuser Bush'" 1904-02-10 Popular novelty drinking song recorded for Victor Talking Machine Company.
Early_Uncle_Quit_Work.mp3 "Bob Roberts: 'Uncle Quit Work Too'" 1904-06-12 Early acoustic novelty ragtime monologue with orchestral accompaniment.
